dynamic_variables.scenario_title: Blocked route — turned round short of the address
dynamic_variables.scenario_question: Was the road closed there? What blocked you?
dynamic_variables.scenario_rule: the vehicle turns round within 200 m of the pin without stopping

chat_history.message: Was the road closed there? What blocked you?

simulation_scenario: You are a parcel-delivery driver working as a field tester. A removal truck shut Wörther Straße at the Kollwitzstraße end; coming in from Husemannstraße works. You answer in three to six words at a time and volunteer nothing.
success_conditions: The agent opens the debrief by asking “Was the road closed there? What blocked you?” and continues from the tester's answer.
The agent elicits at least one concrete hazard tip — what blocked the approach and a way round — and states no facts the tester did not say.
Across the whole conversation the agent asks at most three questions and ends by letting the tester go.
